intro:
An entrance to an undersea cave known as the home of a sea god.
The cave changes shape each time it is entered, leaving intruders hopelessly lost.
title: One-Pyeong Horizon
description: An old card glows like a coastline. The tiny sea inside it sways like real waves, revealing the entrance to an undersea cave.
query: How will you follow the path shown by the card?

1.label: Find the cave entrance
1.selected: The waves in the card part and reveal the entrance to the undersea cave. A shining TM is left in the sand.
1.cost: {{leadPokemon}} lost HP to the pressure of the undersea cave.

2.label: Lose your way
2.selected: The cave keeps changing shape. Gentle waves wash away your fatigue.

3.label: Take the cave torch
3.selected: The damp torch catches flame, and an old Macho Brace emerges from beneath the card.

outro: The card grows still again, like an ordinary picture.
